name: PI Network Management
description: CRO-side investigator intelligence: verified professional PI profiles, site affiliations, sourced public trial evidence, engagement history and study-specific human-reviewed matching for smaller CRO teams.
whenToUse: Use when a CRO needs an internal reusable investigator/site network, source-reviewed clinical trial roles and transparent study-specific PI shortlists, without proprietary licensing or patient records.
whenNotToUse: Not a sponsor CO04 Investigator CRM, patient database, enrollment forecast, claims data product, proprietary Citeline connection, mass outreach/email system, regulatory submission portal, e-signature or standalone account app.

heading.description: Full sidebar name with no icon.

tableMap.description: JSON mapping of ten role names to real host table UUIDs, logical-to-physical field keys and writableFields allowlists.

layoutProfile.description: Versioned native layoutProfile JSON with tabs, cols, visible and heading.

instructions:
Create an internal TrialAgents CR-03 PI Network Management app from the bundled source, aligned with authoring and usage guidance 1.3.9. Reference Citeline Sitetrove+ ONLY for professional investigator/site search, identity, affiliations, sourced trial history and comparison layout; NO Citeline license, proprietary datasets, tiering, recruitment forecasts or patient access. This is a CRO network workspace distinct from sponsor CO04 Investigator CRM.

Critical setup: no app-level auth/accounts, signup, passwords, email sender, logo, imaginary permissions, patient data, or unsolicited contact. TrialAgents supplies its own official linked watermark (https://platform.trialagents.com), backend access enforcement, versioned database records, reviewed mutation and all optional automations. Sidebar must show full name with NO logo. Each screen has only one title and concise subline; no fictional-data banner.

Read all catalog documentation before preparing. First reuse compatible authorized tables or create missing scalar tables via reviewed host operations. Follow real schema, including snake_case keys, multiple:false on ALL fields, kinds, options, nullable references, required fields and table access; do not create app-local users. Set tableMap option to JSON mapping each role to actual approved typeId UUID, fields map logical camelCase to real snake_case physical field, and writableFields array. Read table metadata and construct templateBindings with actual typeId, field allowlist and a valid manifest. Use only approved saved IDs for child references. Creation order: people, institutions and requests first; affiliations, sourced experience, engagements, collaborations and research findings next; actions and PI ratings after parent IDs. Records may be incomplete or denied: never show missing data as zero or claim verified comparison.

Record evidence safeguards: professional name collisions require public identifier / dated affiliation review. Trial experience needs a sourced registry ID, exact investigator role and verified date. Dated affiliations cannot be rewritten to another PI, and duplicate (person,site,start) and (person,registryId,role) are rejected. Engagement logs never send email. Do not archive a PI/site/request with live children or unreadable dependency sources. Every update/archive uses record version captured on editor/confirmation open; missing/stale versions are conflicts, not creation. Copies clear approval/identity/protected fields.

Matching logic: request has three explicit weights (expertise, clinical trial experience, geography) summing to 100%. PI assessment scores must be integers 1-5, require a reviewed state, reviewer, exact criteria version, date, evidence URL and rationale. Score percentage = sum(score_factor * weight_percent) / 5. No reviewed score until complete authorized people, affiliations, public trial evidence, request and ratings reads; zero is NOT an unknown. Edits to reviewed criteria or ratings require a new revision. Results are human-entered professional fit assessments, never proprietary rankings, inferred patient access, PI availability or recruitment forecast. No automatic outreach.

UI: network pulse, PI dossier, site connections, sourced trial evidence, engagement history, PI matching. Native settings gear action tracker:layout with templateLayoutSchema and host-saved layoutProfile; hidden list columns use saved visible/order without removing required form controls. Each transient input/select/textarea has data-ui-state and stable data-action plus name. Use actual input.event.kind/action/form, preserve changed drafts even on failed proposals. Pagination on all registers; labels indicate partial authorized coverage. Preview uses same source in Browser with injected config/bindings but no app account.

Automation setup: zero automations is valid. Only after app saved and user approval, inspect live read_app_automation_guide and automation setup. Optional ChatGPT public professional-source refresh with scope, cadence, timezone, expiry, dedup (person/public ID/site, source URL), coverage report and explicit review-only output; partial findings must be reported, no automatic write or contact. Optional TrialAgents team email reminders only through approved platform email executor with fixed text, existing authorized recipients, consent, expiry and source-state revalidation; never invent interpolated placeholders. No tasks activate from this catalog; a disabled/failed task never blocks app access or draft retention.

Release QA: inspect catalog full schema, source length, native layout declaration, output metadata. Complete architect preflight 1.3.9 locally; live host catalog discovery, prepared QuickJS, manifest sandbox, reviewed DB schema/receipt and automations require independent acceptance. Do not claim publication or deployment because ZIP exists.

Complete host scalar schema (logical names mapped to snake_case physical fields, ! required, ? optional):
people => name:text!, professional_id:text?, specialty:select![Oncology|Neurology|Rare diseases|Immunology|Cardiology|Other], title:text?, country:text?, status:select![Prospect|Introduced|Engaged|Collaborating|Inactive], priority:select?[High|Medium|Low], interest:select?[Unconfirmed|Interested|Not currently interested|Declined], source_url:text!, verified_at:date!, opt_out:boolean?, preferred_channel:select?[Unknown|Through institution|Professional introduction|Conference|Opt out], notes:text?, archived:boolean?
institutions => name:text!, city:text?, country:text!, kind:select?[University hospital|Academic center|Research institute|Clinic|Other], capabilities:text?, source_url:text!, verified_at:date!, archived:boolean?
affiliations => name:text!, person_id:text!, institution_id:text!, role:text!, start_at:date!, end_at:date?, source_url:text!, verified_at:date!, archived:boolean?
experience => name:text!, person_id:text!, institution_id:text?, registry_id:text!, trial_role:text!, phase:select?[Phase 1|Phase 2|Phase 3|Phase 4|Not reported], indication:text?, specialty:text?, source_url:text!, verified_at:date!, archived:boolean?
engagements => name:text!, person_id:text!, institution_id:text?, project_ref:text?, channel:select![Meeting|Call|Conference|Feasibility discussion|Correspondence|Other], occurred_at:date!, owner:text!, purpose:text!, outcome:text!, next_step:text?, notes:text?, archived:boolean?
collaborations => name:text!, person_id:text!, institution_id:text?, project_ref:text!, status:select![Considering|Invited|Discussing|Confirmed|Closed|Declined], invited_at:date?, responded_at:date?, owner:text!, notes:text?, archived:boolean?
actions => name:text!, person_id:text!, engagement_id:text?, owner:text!, due_at:date!, status:select![Open|In progress|Done|Cancelled], completed_at:date?, detail:text?, archived:boolean?
findings => name:text!, person_id:text?, source_url:text!, source_type:select![Registry|Publication|Institution profile|Other public source], topic:text!, verified_at:date!, reviewer:text?, reviewed_at:date?, status:select![Candidate|Draft|Reviewed|Rejected], rationale:text?, archived:boolean?
requests => name:text!, study_code:text!, indication:text!, country:text!, phase:select![Phase 1|Phase 2|Phase 3|Phase 4|Other], owner:text!, weight_expertise:number!, weight_experience:number!, weight_geography:number!, criteria_version:text!, status:select![Draft|Active|Closed], description:text?, archived:boolean?
ratings => name:text!, request_id:text!, person_id:text!, expertise_score:number?, experience_score:number?, geography_score:number?, criteria_version:text!, assessor:text!, assessed_at:date!, evidence_url:text!, rationale:text!, status:select![Draft|Reviewed|Rejected], archived:boolean?

Host app behavior: create, edit, duplicate, soft archive under approved proposals. Optional source URLs stored as text. No direct external email, API credentials or proprietary data. Always check authorized record completeness.
Host release rules: forms submit data-action=save; output html/css/state separately; host injects templateConfiguration and templateBindings once. Edits/archives send recordId and editor-open expectedVersion, including zero. Proposals are not commits; preserve drafts on ignore/failure, reconcile receipts and reopen after confirmation. Optional empty date/ref/number/select values are null. All mapped fields including optional ones must be authorized and present, archived/optOut explicit booleans; missing access never means false. Reads are 80 rows x 9 pages/role, 720 rows per role, 90 reads across ten roles plus proposal. Known stable totals, scalar values and complete reads are required. New rows require all mapped write fields; changed fields cannot be silently dropped outside grants. Ratings require study request status write scope for an atomic same-status parent version guard. Concurrent criteria/rating edits conflict. Reviewed findings/ratings cannot be downgraded or archived. Close an active study brief and create a new criteria revision before changing evidence used in active reviewed matching. Opt-out remains editable and immediately withholds matching. Independent Database edits need reconciliation; guards are app-level, not database-wide constraints. Hidden/unlisted fields are reachable through Additional fields, revealed automatically on errors. Native screen/field visibility is presentation, not access control. Each child proposal atomically pins every populated direct parent at its editor-open version; it requires parent status write scope for people/requests and name write scope for other parent roles. Re-read and reopen after a conflict. These same-value guard updates advance host versions; never claim they represent changed business facts. Creating or editing an assessment and changing its source evidence cannot both commit from the same stale parent snapshot. No source queries or notifications run in the browser.

quickStart: Open inside existing TrialAgents account and app permissions, no secondary login or identity table; host watermark links to https://platform.trialagents.com.
Review and create ten scalar database roles with every field multiple:false and real snake_case physical keys, field kinds and exact select options stated in these catalog instructions.
Save people, institutions and match requests first; use approved receipt IDs in dated affiliations, trial experience, engagement, review ratings and findings.
Map tableMap to actual UUID role typeIds and logical-to-physical fields; bind authorized manifest and fields, then prepare this frontend-js catalog version using its digest.
Check readiness and source completeness; no score if a source, verified assessment or current criteria version is missing.
Use native layout gear to reorder screens/columns; creation/editing/soft archive use host-reviewed proposals.
Do not configure any automation unless explicitly requested. Save the app first, then consult live platform automation guide.

Discover exact ID/version/digest; prepare_app_from_template with one requestKey; revise via replacesPreviewId/expectedDigest; confirm through host review and verify stable app/record receipt IDs. Preserve app identity, current version, unrelated settings and access during later edits. Never redeclare injected bindings/configuration or import fictional demo IDs. Record creation requires all mapped fields writable, including explicit false booleans; optional null differs from unavailable data. Each rating write also pins and advances the parent request version atomically; request status write scope is required.

Optional single-step typed notification, only if requested; replace placeholders with saved app version, authorized table and registered recipient identities, approved expiry: {"name":"PI network follow-up recorded","authoringKey":"cr03_followup_email_v1","appId":"REPLACE_WITH_SAVED_APP_UUID","appVersion":0,"recordTypeId":"REPLACE_WITH_ACTIONS_TABLE_UUID","trigger":{"kind":"database","typeId":"REPLACE_WITH_ACTIONS_TABLE_UUID","events":["created","updated"],"fields":["status"],"becomes":{"field":"status","operator":"equals","value":"Open"}},"fields":["status","archived"],"conditions":[{"field":"archived","operator":"not_equals","value":true}],"steps":[{"id":"notify_owner","kind":"email","to":["REPLACE_WITH_REGISTERED_AUTHORIZED_OWNER_EMAIL"],"subject":"PI network follow-up recorded","text":"Open https://platform.trialagents.com to review your authorized PI network follow-up queue and recorded contact preferences."}],"users":[],"expiresAt":"REPLACE_WITH_APPROVED_ISO_EXPIRY","maxRunsPerDay":10}
documentation.dataContract: Ten scalar roles: people, institutions, affiliations, experience, engagements, collaborations, actions, findings, requests, ratings. All fields have multiple:false; nullable references use scalar UUID text, not arrays. Snake_case actual field keys per setup instructions; fields of date kind: verified_at, start_at, end_at, occurred_at, invited_at, responded_at, due_at, completed_at, reviewed_at, assessed_at. Number fields: weight_expertise, weight_experience, weight_geography, expertise_score, experience_score, geography_score. Boolean: opt_out, archived. Fields storing URL, professional notes, rationale, institutional source and project ID are plain text. Every select field uses the explicitly enumerated values in catalog instructions. Role references: person_id->people; institution_id->institutions; engagement_id->engagements; request_id->requests. Every table requires a real typeId, fields map, writableFields, and inherited host permissions; not all business records may be visible. No patient fields, no private PI contact scraping, no app-managed user role. Include source URL, verification date and assessor for evidence and reviewed ratings. Every mapped scalar must be present in authorized reads; optional null is valid, missing/denied is incomplete. Explicit opt_out/archived booleans are required for coverage. Optional blank dates, numbers, selects and references are written as null. Total must remain stable; pages are 80 rows, at most 9 per role (720 rows and 90 reads across ten roles). A score never means availability or permission to contact. Child writes include version-pinned same-value parent guard updates: status for people/requests; name for other populated parents. Require those write fields. Existing external Database changes must be reconciled; this app does not install database-wide constraints.
documentation.interactionContract: Six screens have one title and one subline. Full app name in sidebar without icon. Native tracker:layout with persisted reviewed templateLayoutSchema and layoutProfile changes; tabs and columns reorder while hidden fields remain editable in standard full record editor. Filters and forms use native event kind/action/value/form with data-ui-state on every control; retain all draft values on errors. Parent IDs and versions pinned on edit/archive; proposals create/update only, Delete is soft archive. Page through each source register; partial/unknown/denied reads block derived totals and scores. No email, portal or direct outreach in UI. Host watermark is official linked TrialAgents brand. No fictional-data disclaimer banner. Changes to criteria and ratings serialize through a pinned request version. Active reviewed evidence is protected; close the brief and create a new criteria revision before changing its evidence. Missing/duplicate evidence and opt-outs withhold scores. Native columns and hidden form fields follow saved layout; Additional fields keeps required controls reachable.
documentation.lifecycle: Prepare from catalog digest and approved real saved table bindings; host controls user identity, permissions, edits, logs and automation. Create parents first, then children using returned UUID receipts. Match requests and reviewed assessments are study-version scoped; revisions and source links remain traceable. Approved ratings and public trial claims must not silently survive evidence or criteria changes. Archive checks dependent table completeness. New version does not mutate existing saved apps. No enabled task, email or external contact without separate reviewed setup. No submission, publication, research execution or deployment is implied by preview.
limitations: Benchmark is Citeline Sitetrove+, not a connected proprietary Citeline dataset; no claims, patient, commercial enrollment, activity tier or investigator availability predictions.
Professional source URLs and registry IDs in demo data are fictional examples, not verified real investigators or trial evidence.
All custom source apps have host app-level access; do not infer field/section access from hidden HTML, and retain private notes only under authorized host permissions.
No user account/login, app logo, standalone outreach connector, scheduled task, automatic email or patient-level data.
Full matching coverage requires complete authorized reads of people, experience, affiliations, requests and ratings; missing totals, denied reads or read limits block authoritative scores.
Live catalog discovery, compiled QuickJS host, sanitized manifest browser, reviewed schema saves, native layout persistence and platform automation delivery are UNVERIFIED in the standalone package.

examples.prompt: Build a PI Network Management app for our CRO and import only reviewed public PI and institution evidence.
examples.expectedBehavior: Create ten host-authorized scalar tables, review people and institutions, then link dated affiliations and public registry roles using actual approved receipt IDs. Do not create app accounts.

examples.prompt: Build a study-specific PI shortlist with explicit clinical expertise, trial experience and geography weights.
examples.expectedBehavior: Create a study request revision with three weights summing to 100. Capture reviewed PI assessments with dated source URLs and assessor rationale. Only compare fully reviewed evidence.

examples.prompt: Log a feasibility conversation with a PI and a follow-up action.
examples.expectedBehavior: Propose a dated professional engagement and follow-up via host-reviewed writes, respect opt-out and keep historical notes under project access.

examples.prompt: Research public PI trial experience in the selected countries.
examples.expectedBehavior: Propose public-source candidate findings with registry IDs, source dates, identity disambiguation and uncertainty. No proprietary Citeline dataset or patient information.

examples.prompt: Use PI Network Management with no monitoring configured.
examples.expectedBehavior: Open and work in existing authorized records; do not create any task, automation, email, connection or background scheduler.

tasks.whenUseful: Only after an explicit CRO user opt-in for periodic publicly verifiable PI role/affiliation updates or known team follow-up due dates. Manual app works unchanged without automations.
tasks.readRequirements:
After saving, read read_app_automation_guide, read_automation_setup, list_app_automations and read_app_automation. Reuse the shared owner/workspace runner and existing objective; stable authoringKey cr03_pi_public_source_update. Suggested every 14 days at 09:00 in the owner-confirmed IANA timezone, approved anchor and expiry, 14-day initial lookback, coalesced catch-up, bounded 20 profiles/run. Use current app-bound read fields/inheritAppAccess:true, check optOut and approved source scope at execution. No per-app ChatGPT Task. Respect paused/disconnected setup; prefer supported Work chat, high reasoning and latest most capable available model, reporting actual host settings separately. Never invent host IDs or model parameters.

Use public CTIS/trial registry, institution and publication metadata only. Match professional identifier plus affiliation; dedupe by identity, URL and evidence date. Return exact URLs, verification dates, ambiguity and source gaps. One-time drafts stay in the authorized conversation; recurring drafts stay in private permission-checked monitoring results/history. No reports table and no automatic database writes. A user can separately review Candidate findings using real optional person UUIDs. No winner, availability or consent inference. Complete scope with zero findings is completed; no_update only with complete coverage and an approved quiet policy. Partial/blocked/expired/revoked work does not advance coverage. Preserve receipts/checkpoints on retries. Optional email is a separate single-step TrialAgents action when actions.status enters Open, rechecking archived is not true; fixed subject PI network follow-up recorded, fixed body Open https://platform.trialagents.com to review your authorized PI network follow-up queue and recorded contact preferences. Only the registered owner and specifically selected currently authorized teammates; never investigator/contact addresses. No research completion email or second schedule. Delivery failure does not rerun research. No job/email is activated by template metadata; manual use works without setup. Preserve IDs, disabled state, hidden configuration and grants on edits; outcomes belong in Logs.
tasks.outputContract: Return citations, public verified date, identity disambiguation, new/revised professional evidence, uncertain links and coverage summary. Research output is a review proposal, never auto-updated approved PI facts or outreach. On partial/denied reads: no claims of complete absence, no unattended close/no_update unless full coverage and explicit quiet policy. Email only via TrialAgents platform with fixed text, approved team recipients, deduplication and expiry; never invent placeholders or send to PIs.
tasks.promptExample: Only if approved: every 14 days in Europe/Berlin, inspect authorized CRO PI Network records and public EU/UK registry/institution publication sources for changed professional PI roles, dated affiliations and trial participation related to the selected indications and geography. Report source links, verification dates, identity ambiguity, deduplicate by public ID + affiliation and registry ID + role. Propose findings for human review only, preserve old versions, report partial/failed coverage and never email PIs. Disable after the user-defined end date; zero automations is valid.
